dataset_observation: Dataset observation (OPS-SAT-AD, 484 multi-channel incidents): All 1032 observed channel-pair windows show windows_overlap=True (1032/1032 pairs). This is a characteristic of the OPS-SAT-AD grouping rule under which spacecraft incidents are formed from channels with overlapping anomaly windows. The partial-overlap logic is implemented and will activate correctly for datasets where non-overlapping channel pairs are present.
